source: Dung (1995); research/PITFALLS.md Pitfall 8 (a cycle's open status must name itself as a cycle rather than a bare shrug)
description: a single claim attacks itself and nothing else is in the graph
reasoning: a self-loop is the degenerate one-node cycle: the claim's own node has one live attacker (itself) and can never reach zero, so it stays undec exactly as a longer cycle's members do
